comment: Entry point 2 prioritises integration over replacement. This is pragmatic, but integration may preserve poor data quality, unsafe systems, proprietary constraints, or unmanageable technical debt.

anchor.note: p.90 l.Lines 81-90 read as the printed page; section 4.2.1 agrees

public.text: Entry point 2 prioritises integration over replacement. This is pragmatic, but integration may preserve poor data quality, unsafe systems, proprietary constraints, or unmanageable technical debt.
public.suggestedRevision: Make integration conditional on a structured assessment of safety, data quality, supportability, security, legal compliance, interface feasibility, cost, and expected remaining life.
